abstract.text: Invite people to your Project map and the Activities they need.

inlineContent.text: Project and Activity invitations are separate. Project permissions control access to the map; Activity permissions control access to that round of work. Sharing one does not automatically share the other.
Open the Project’s More menu, then tap Share.
Tap Start Sharing if you have not shared it before.
In the sharing controls, choose who can join and whether they can view or edit.
Send the invitation to your collaborators.
After sharing has been set up, tap Control to manage access. A QR code is available when access by link is enabled.
Share the Project first and ask collaborators to accept that invitation.
Open the Activity’s More menu, then Share.
Tap Start Sharing if needed, choose permissions, and send the Activity invitation.

The owner can allow viewing or editing during Planning and Active. Ended Activities support viewing only. Starting an Activity renews its invitation and removes previous participants, so send a new invitation after starting.
Open the invitation on a device with LinkMap installed. Accept the Project invitation before the Activity invitation.
To scan a QR invitation, tap Projects, open Project Actions (the ellipsis), then tap Scan. Activities also has a Scan action in Activity Actions.
After joining, choose the shared Project in Projects and open the Activity you were invited to.

Check that you are using the Apple Account that received the invitation and that you accepted both invitations when an Activity needs Project access. Ask the owner for a current Activity invitation if the Activity has just started.
Ending an Activity removes existing collaborators’ access. The owner can share its history again with view-only permissions.

abstract.text: Keep your places together and plan the work around them.
Find places in LinkMap and open a maps app when you need directions.
Use your Apple Account to keep your LinkMap Projects available across your devices.
